vs/topaz-alternative-mac.text: This isn't a "Crisp beats Topaz" pitch.
This is the big one Topaz has no answer for.

Being concrete about the enhancement side, since it's the fair comparison to Topaz: Crisp's standard upscaler is Real-ESRGAN (ncnn/Vulkan), running 2×–16× on-device, with the large steps reserved for small sources.
It is Crisp's answer to Topaz's Starlight, minus the cloud.
Honest limits: this is one upscaler with a handful of models, not Topaz's deep model catalogue, and it enhances and restores footage you already have.
What it won't do is replace Topaz's deep pro restoration pipeline: on the hardest archival work, or when you want per-artifact sliders, Topaz's broader lineup wins.
Pick Crisp for own-it, offline, simple, and edit-too; pick Topaz for the deepest control and the highest ceiling.
